title: Disentangling the Expressivity of RoPE
abstract: arXiv:2608.11909v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Two accounts recur in explanations of the success of rotary position embeddings (RoPE). Expressivity studies associate periodic position information with modular predicates, whereas mechanistic and long-context studies emphasize positional anchors and local offsets. We formalize both accounts for fully uniform, finite-precision soft-attention transformers. We find that, if every rotary component is periodic, RoPE transformers recognize exactly the languages definable in past temporal logic with modular predicates. Conventional RoPE is different: The rotations it computes never repeat. This yields a precision-dependent bounded simulation of fixed-offset look-back operators, rather than an all-length modular characterization. Controlled experiments match this separation: Constructed periodic schedules length-generalize on modular languages, while conventional RoPE behaves more like a bounded locality bias and can impair tasks requiring pos

translated_title: 解开旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）的表达能力之谜
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11909v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：在解释旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）成功时，通常有两种说法反复出现。表达性研究将周期性位置信息与模谓词联系起来，而机制性和长上下文研究则强调位置锚点和局部偏移。我们针对完全均匀、有限精度的软注意力Transformer，将这两种说法都形式化。我们发现，如果每个旋转组件都是周期性的，那么RoPE变换器恰好能识别过去时间逻辑中带有模谓词可定义的语言。传统的RoPE则不同：它计算的旋转从不重复。这产生了依赖于精度的固定偏移回看操作符的有界模拟，而不是全长度模特征化。受控实验与这一区分一致：构造的周期性调度在模语言上能进行长度泛化，而传统的RoPE更像是一种有界局部性偏置，可能会损害需要位置敏感信息的任务。
tldr: 本文区分了旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）的两种解释，证明周期性RoPE能精确表达带模谓词的过去时间逻辑语言，而传统非周期RoPE仅提供有界局部性模拟，且实验验证了性能差异。
en_tdlr: This paper disentangles two accounts of rotary position embeddings (RoPE), showing that periodic RoPE exactly captures past temporal logic with modular predicates, while conventional non-periodic RoPE only offers bounded locality simulation, with experiments confirming the performance gap.
